senses.gloss:
जल् (जलति) 1.
a. To be sharp;
wealthy. (कि) जलति, जालयति.
1. 10.
a. To cover as a veil or net.

जल (लं) 1.
n. Water; a perfume;
uterus of a cow; frigidity.
a.
Cold, stupid, idiotic.

जाल (लं) 1.
n. A net; a lattice; a
multitude; an unblown flower;
pride; magic.
m. Cadamba tree.
f. (ती) A small cucumber.

जलक (कं) 1.
n. A shell, a conch.

जालक (कः-लिका) 1.
n. A bud; a net;
a nest; a plantain; pride.
m.
A lattice.
f. Armour; woollen
cloth; a leech; window; iron.

जल-कण्टक (कः) 1.
m. Aquatic plant
(Trapa bispinosa); a crocodile.

जल-कर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Making water.
m. Tax or rent for fisheries, &c.

जल-करङ्क (ङ्कः) 1.
m. A cocoanut; a
shell; a lotus; a cloud; a wave.

जल-काक (कः) 1.
m. A bird, the diver.

जल-कूपी (पी) 3.
f. Whirlpool; a
pond, a spring, a well.

जल-क्रिया (या) 1.
f. Presenting wa-
ter to the manes, at funerals.

जल-क्रीडा (डा) 1.
f. Sporting or
gamboling in water.

जलङ्ग (ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
a. Aquatic, fre-
quenting water.
m. Colocynth.

जल-ज (जः) 1.
m. Idem. n. A lotus.
f. A plant, Bassia.
a. Aquatic.

जल-जन्तु (न्तुः) 2.
m. Any fish; an
aquatic or amphibious animal.

जल-तरङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. A wave; me-
tal cup used as a musical glass.

जल-तापिक (कः) 1.
m. The
hilsā or
sable fish; also another kind.

जल-द (दः) 1.
m. A cloud; a fra-
grant grass.
a. Giving water.

जलद-संहति (तिः) 2.
f. Gathering
of clouds, cloudiness.

जल-धर (रः) 1.
m. A cloud; the
ocean; a grass.
a. Holding water.

जला_धार (रः) 1.
m. A pond, a lake.

जल-निवह (हः) 1.
m. Quantity or
abundance of water.

जाल-न्धर (रः) 1.
m. The country
Jallindhar, part of
Lahore.

जल-पटल (लं) 1.
n. Much water; a
cloud, line of clouds.

जल-पति (तिः) 2.
m. Varuna, the In-
dian
Neptune; the ocean.

जल-पिप्पली (ली) 3.
f. An aquatic
plant (Commelina salicifolia).

जल-प्राय (यं) 1.
n. A place or country
abounding with water.

जल-प्रिय (यः) 1.
m. The
Chātaca;
a fish.
a. Fond of water.

जल-बुद्वुद (दं) 1.
n. A bubble of water.

जल-भू (भू) 3.
m. A cloud; a plant.

जल-मण्डुक (कः) 1.
m. Playing or gam-
boling in the water.

जल-मार्ग (र्गः) 1.
m. A drain or issue
from a pond, &c.

जल-यन्त्र (न्त्रं) 1.
n. Water-works, or
machine for raising water.

जलयन्त्र-गृह (हं) 1.
n. A house on
the water for the hot season.

जल-रङ्क (ङ्कः) 1.
m. A kind of crane.

जल-रञ्ज (ञ्जः) 1.
m. A kind of crane.

जल-रण्ड (ण्डः) 1.
m. A whirlpool; a
sprinkling of water; a snake.

जल-रूप (पः) 1.
m. The fish on the
banners of
Kāma or Cupid.

जल-लता (ता) 1.
f. A wave; a billow.

जल-वालक (कः) 1.
m. The
Vindhya
range of mountains.

जल-वाहन (नं) 1.
n. Flow of water.
नी
f. Watercourse, canal.

जल-विल्व (ल्वः) 1.
m. A crab; a
tortoise; a piece of water.

जल-विषुव (वं) 1.
n. The autumnal
equinox, sun's entering
Libra.

जला_शय (यः-यं) 1.
m. A pond; a
lake; the ocean.
n. Fragrant
grass.
a. Stupid, dull, cold.

जला-शायिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
a. Lying
in water as a penance.

जल-सूचि (चिः) 2.
m. A fish, a pike;
a propoise; a heron; a plant
(Trapa bispinosa).
f. A leech.

जल-संसर्ग (र्गः) 1.
m. A mixture made
of water, a dilution.

जला_ञ्चल (लं) 1.
n. A natural water-
course or channel; Valisneria.

जला_ञ्जलि (लिः) 2.
f. A handful of
water; water in the palms of the
hand as presented in oblation.

जला_टन (नः) 1.
m. A heron.
f. (नी)
A leech.
a. Moving in water.

जला_त्मिका (का) 1.
f. A leech; a well.

जला_र्द्र (र्द्रः-र्द्रा) 1.
m. f. n. Wet cloth
or clothes.
a. Wet.

जालिक (कः) 1.
m. A spider; fish-
erman; a hunter using nets.
a.
Cheating, juggling.

जले-चर (रः-री-रं)
a. Aquatic.
m. A
fish; a water-fowl.

जलेच्छया (या) 1.
f. A plant (Helitro-
pium Indicum).

जले_न्द्र (न्द्रः) 1.
m. Varuna; a
Jaina;
ocean of fresh water.

जले_श्वर (रः) 1.
m. Varuna the deity
of water; the ocean.

जल्प् जल्पति 1.
a. To speak articu-
lately; to prattle, to talk.

जल्पित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Said.
n. Chat-
tering, babbling.

जालकिनी (नी) 3.
f. A sheep, an ewe.

जालिन् (ली-लिनी-लि)
a. Having a
net lattice; or illusory, decep-
tive.
m. A fisherman; hunter;
juggler.
f. A painting-room.

जाल्म (ल्मः-ल्मा-ल्मं)
a. Low (man); cru-
el, harsh, inconsiderate.

जल-कल्भष (षः) 1.
m. Poison at the
churning of the ocean.
